overview: The subcommittee refined the stakeholder communications matrix for the Medford High School project, identifying target audiences and specific outreach methods such as tours and bill inserts. Members also reviewed a schedule of public forums and committee milestones to narrow building options through June 2026.

items.title: Stakeholder Communications Matrix
items.summary: The committee reviewed a grid categorizing groups such as the City Council, abutters, and teachers to determine their primary concerns and preferred communication channels.

items.title: Outreach Channels and Community Engagement
items.summary: Members discussed using local media, school tours, the Mayor’s newsletter, and water bill inserts to reach residents and parents, including those requiring translation services.

items.title: Specialty Stakeholder Outreach
items.summary: The subcommittee proposed targeted engagement for seniors via the Council on Aging, students via building tours, and local businesses through the Chamber of Commerce.

items.title: Community Meeting Calendar and Milestones
items.summary: The committee reviewed a timeline of forums and meetings intended to narrow 29 project options down to 3–5 by late April, with a final selection targeted for June 10.

items.title: Approval of Communications Plan Updates
items.summary: Approved updating the communications plan based on the subcommittee's discussion for submission to the full building committee.
